note: Thanks+plea: waited-heard, new-song, blessed-trust, proclaim-wondrous, delight-to-do-will, glad-news-of-deliverance, not-hidden-in-heart, iniquities-overwhelm/heart-fails, seekers-rejoice, poor-and-needy

278212.gloss: I waited patiently, he heard my cry

dims.v: I waited patiently, he heard my cry
the self waited patiently for the LORD, who inclined to it and heard its cry - patient waiting rewarded
v1: 'I WAITED PATIENTLY for the LORD; he inclined to me and heard my CRY' - the operation is a sustained, quiet waiting that God bent down to answer; patience met by attention.

278319.gloss: a new song, that many may trust

dims.v: a new song, that many may trust
God put a new song of praise in the self's mouth; many will see, fear, and put their trust in the LORD - praise that propagates trust

v3: 'He put a NEW SONG in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will SEE and FEAR, and put their TRUST in the LORD' - the operation is testimony that spreads: the interior's rescued song moves others to reverent trust.

278326.gloss: blessed is the man who trusts the LORD, not the proud

dims.v: blessed is the man who trusts the LORD, not the proud
blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust and does not turn to the proud or to liars - trust rightly placed

v4: 'BLESSED is the man who makes the LORD his TRUST, who does not turn to the PROUD, to those who go astray after a lie' - the operation weighs as happy the interior that leans on God rather than on proud liars.

278347.gloss: I will proclaim your countless wondrous deeds

dims.v: I will proclaim your countless wondrous deeds
the self proclaims and tells God's wondrous deeds and thoughts, too many to number - praise for the innumerable works

v5: 'your WONDROUS deeds and your THOUGHTS toward us; none can compare... I will PROCLAIM and tell of them' - the operation is overflowing testimony; the interior cannot keep silent about deeds beyond counting.

278372.gloss: I delight to do your will, your law within my heart

dims.v: I delight to do your will, your law within my heart
the self delights to do God's will, its law within its heart - obedience become desire
v8: 'I DELIGHT to do your WILL, O my God; your law is within my HEART' - the operation is obedience felt as joy: the law is not an external weight but an internalised delight.

278380.gloss: I told the glad news, I did not restrain my lips

dims.v: I told the glad news, I did not restrain my lips
the self has told the glad news of deliverance in the great congregation and has not restrained its lips - unrestrained public witness

v9: 'I have told the GLAD NEWS of deliverance in the great congregation; behold, I have not RESTRAINED my lips' - the operation is a witness that refuses to hold back; the interior publishes God's rescue openly.

278221.gloss: I have not hidden your righteousness in my heart

dims.v: I have not hidden your righteousness in my heart
the self has not hidden God's deliverance within its heart but has spoken of his faithfulness and steadfast love - refusing to keep the good news private

v10: 'I have NOT HIDDEN your deliverance within my HEART... I have not CONCEALED your steadfast love' - the operation is the deliberate opposite of secrecy: the interior will not lock God's goodness inside but broadcasts it.

278245.gloss: iniquities overwhelm me, my heart fails

dims.v: iniquities overwhelm me, my heart fails
evils have encompassed the self beyond number; its iniquities have overtaken it till it cannot see, more than the hairs of its head, so its heart fails - being swamped by guilt

v12: 'my INIQUITIES have overtaken me, till I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head; my HEART FAILS me' - the operation is inundation: the interior is buried under uncountable guilt and its courage gives out.

278285.gloss: may all who seek you rejoice

dims.v: may all who seek you rejoice
the self prays that all who seek God may rejoice and be glad, and those who love his salvation say 'Great is the LORD' - seeking that ends in joyful praise

v16: 'may all who SEEK you REJOICE and be GLAD in you; may those who LOVE your salvation say continually, Great is the LORD!' - the operation widens the self's rescue into a prayer that all seekers share its joy.

278295.gloss: I am poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for me

dims.v: I am poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for me
the self is poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for it; he is its help and deliverer - lowliness confident of God's attention

v17: 'As for me, I am POOR and NEEDY, but the Lord takes THOUGHT for me. You are my help and my deliverer' - the operation holds together weakness and confidence: the interior owns its poverty yet rests in being remembered by God.
v1: 'he inclined to me and HEARD my cry' - the answer the patient waiting received.

278303.gloss: he drew me up from the pit

dims.v: he drew me up from the pit
v2: 'He DREW me up from the pit of destruction... and set my feet upon a rock' - the deliverance the new song celebrates.
v13: 'Be pleased, O LORD, to DELIVER me!' - the rescue the poor-and-needy self still asks for.
